en.t: There was no reaction at all.

units.source_text: 只有无声的低话，像烟雾似的在空中飘荡。

en.t: Only silent murmurs drifted through the air like smoke.

units.source_text: 听不清是敌意，还是忍住笑的嘲弄，那低语追逼着男人，令人难以忍受。

en.t: It was impossible to tell whether they were hostility or mockery with laughter held back; those whispers pressed in on the man unbearably.
